title: The Jesse private Rooftop HotTub and putting green
description:
Why We Love This Home
✔ Private Rooftop Deck
✔ Hot Tub + Fire Pit – The ultimate post-Broadway wind-down
✔ 4 Bedrooms | 4 Full Bathrooms
✔ Prime Nashville Location – Close to top dining, nightlife, and must-see attractions
The Space
This thoughtfully designed home offers multiple levels of living, giving everyone room to spread out while still coming together with ease.
Perfect For:
• Group trips
• Bachelorette & bachelor weekends
• Family getaways
• Music lovers & city explorers

The space
Welcome to The Jesse — a high-demand 4 bedroom, 4 bathroom Nashville stay built for unforgettable group experiences.

If you’re traveling with friends, celebrating something big, or planning a girls’ weekend — this layout was designed for you.
✔️ 4 Private Bedrooms
✔️ 4 Full Bathrooms (zero sharing)
✔️ Private Rooftop Deck
✔️ Exclusive Hot Tub
✔️ Fast WiFi + Smart TVs
✔️ Free Parking

Why Groups Choose The Jesse
Most Nashville Airbnbs make groups share bathrooms.
Not here.
Every bedroom has its own full bath — which means:
• No waiting
• No awkward hallway traffic
• No crowded mornings
Just smooth, stress-free stays.

The Rooftop That Sells It
The private rooftop hot tub is the feature guests book for. Includes fire pit and putting green
Morning coffee or Sunset cocktails before Broadway.
Late-night soaking under the lights.
It’s private. It’s elevated. It feels exclusive.
And prime weekends book quickly.

Designed for Celebrations
Perfect for:
• Bachelorette parties
• 30th & 40th birthdays
• Girls’ trips
• Couples traveling together
• Family gatherings
• Corporate retreats
This isn’t just a place to sleep — it’s your group’s home base for the weekend.

The Experience
Modern. Clean. Elevated.
You’ll have the space to gather, the privacy to relax, and the rooftop to make memories.

High-Demand Notice
Homes with:
• 4 bedrooms
• 4 bathrooms
• Private rooftop hot tubs
Are limited in Nashville — especially this close to everything.
If your dates are available, secure them before someone else does.

Other things to note
This home does have 4 floors of stairs with no elevator
